subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) OKL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0155797cb13ff414fe8eff9bab0b7bdf86ac8f5dda3d2dbebc16625d1342d02d.png] 

Option 2) UPR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b82ff55a5176ea720f073de4e3b3a5d427901e0919267131b0174047fc807cf.png] 

Option 3) DYA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f3e4ea9d1bdb629ecc264c8f341f3f5846615e99b40da493a4d13090ed926a5.png] 

Option 4) LGI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0549e4e151973470c00bc3de0f476d75dd37700ca723e5d13572e06f0b5e3a22.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'OKL' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
